Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in Step 4 by incorrectly classifying Volker Schlöndorff as a "German-French filmmaker" and concluding that he is from two countries (Germany and France). While the film *Swann in Love* is a Franco-German co-production, Volker Schlöndorff is exclusively German by nationality (born in Berlin, Germany). He is not dual-nationality French. Consequently, the Planner drew an incorrect conclusion that the directors are from different countries, whereas both Rudolf Jugert (German) and Volker Schlöndorff (German) are actually from the same country (Germany). This error invalidates the final "No" answer.
